{{Quote|This wasn't supposed to happen.|Mara Jade Skywalker to her husband Luke Skywalker, after discovering her pregnancy|<ref name="Balance Point">''[[The New Jedi Order: Balance Point]]''</ref>}}
'''Birth control''' were methods or devices used to prevent [[Reproduction/Legends|pregnancy]]. The [[Ho'Din/Legends|Ho'Dins]] were masters of [[Plant/Legends|herbal]] birth control.<ref name="GG4">''[[Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races]]''</ref> When [[Mara Jade Skywalker]] discovered that she was pregnant with her [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|husband]], the first though that occurred to her was that this couldn't have happened, as her [[Coomb spore|disease]] could harm any unborn [[Ben Skywalker|offspring]] and she had therefore taken all precautions to keep herself from becoming pregnant.<ref name="Balance Point" />
